description: Read the spreads (Druckbögen) of an open document or of an .idml/.indd file as a layout description (JSON): per spread the page names, parent page prefixes (Musterseiten), page margins and every object with type, page, x, y, width, height in mm from the top left corner of its page, rotation, layer, object style, fill, text wrap, text frame options and threading order (chain_index); images and PDFs with file path, scale, offset and graphic bounds; texts as paragraph lists with paragraph and character styles and local formatting (Laufweite and other overrides, which the line breaks depend on). Groups, lines, ellipses, rotated objects and stories with tables or anchored objects are kept as unchanged IDML (type raw, raw_xml). The result can be passed to build_issue or build_snippet unchanged. Each object kept as IDML and each such story also carries description, a readable account that building ignores: for objects kind (group, line, ellipse, polygon, rectangle, text_frame …), page_name, x_mm, y_mm, width_mm, height_mm, rotation_deg (as InDesign shows it), own_width_mm and own_height_mm of a rotated object, layer, object_style, fill, tint, stroke, stroke_weight_pt, stroke_type, story of a text frame, graphic {type, file}, for lines from_mm, to_mm, length_mm, line_start, line_end, for groups children[] in the same form; for stories paragraphs[] {style, text} with [table n] and [anchored object n] in the text, tables[] {rows, columns, header_rows, footer_rows, table_style, column_widths_mm, row_heights_mm, cells[] {row, column, row_span, column_span, cell_style, fill, paragraphs}} and anchored_objects[] (with anchored_position). include_parent_pages true adds parent_spreads[] {name, prefix, base_name, pages, parents, margins, objects} – the parent pages (Musterseiten) with their objects (page number, running heads, frames, lines) in the same format – and their texts as parent_stories; build_issue takes parent pages from the template and ignores both. Pass output_path to write the JSON to a file; the answer then carries the counts only (include_layout true adds the layout). Read-only for the document.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used.

include_layout.description: Return the layout in the answer. Default true without output_path, false with it.

include_parent_pages.description: Also read the parent pages (Musterseiten) with their objects as parent_spreads and parent_stories. Default false.

output_path.description: Write the layout description to this .json file.

pages.description: Only the spreads containing these pages (page names as printed, e.g. ["32"]). Default: all spreads.

path.description: An .idml, .indd or .indt file to read instead of an open document. An .indd/.indt is opened as an invisible copy and closed again.

name: read_layout
title: Read a layout description
